C0308.title: Authorities Disrupt Four Major IoT DDoS Botnets
C0308.summary: On March 19, 2026, the U.S. Department of Justice said authorities disrupted command-and-control infrastructure used by the Aisuru, KimWolf, JackSkid, and Mossad IoT DDoS botnets. Court documents alleged that Aisuru issued more than 200,000 DDoS attack commands, while JackSkid, KimWolf, and Mossad issued more than 90,000, 25,000, and 1,000 commands respectively.
